ios.desc:
Enter the world of digital possibilities in mObywatel!
Install the application and handle your official matters simply and conveniently. Always keep your documents at hand on your phone.

Easy start
Install the application, confirm your identity with a trusted profile, electronic identity card, or electronic banking and you're ready to go!

What will you gain?
• Digital documents in one place: mDowód, mobile driving license, different IDs, Large Family Card, and more.
• Services that will help you handle official matters and protect yourself against fraudsters – Block PESEL and Safely on the Net.
• Quick access to your prescriptions, the number of penalty points, or air quality measurements.
• Notifications when your documents or third-party liability insurance policies expire.

These are just some of the services and functions offered by the mObywatel application.

Download the application and check it out now!

More information about the application can be found at www.info.mobywatel.gov.pl.

You can find the accessibility declaration at this link: www.gov.pl/mobywatel-w-aplikacji/deklaracja.

Our technical support can assist you on working days from 7:00 to 18:00. Call us at +48 42 253 54 74 or email mobywatel-pomoc@coi.gov.pl.

The application is being developed by the Centre for Information Technology www.coi.gov.pl.

quotes.text:
this is false equivalency. in poland we have similar to passkey implementation in government issued application - mobywatel [0] that allows to login to government websites. in 2022 according to published data it had almost 9m installations [1] and a lot of them are old ppl, so its not like only neckbeards would know this ancient technology

sure there are some issues sometimes (outages and others), but most of the time they work like charm and solve a lot of issues with login+password issues.

- [0] https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=pl.nask.mobywatel&hl=en

- [1] https://dane.gov.pl/en/dataset/2919/resource/43845,mobywatel-ilosc-zainstalowanych-aplikacji/table?page=1&per_page=20&q=&sort=
quotes.story_title: Passkeys were invented by engineers with zero understanding of consumer brain

In Poland government issued mObywatel app stores ID cards, driving licence, student ID card, car ownership certificate, digital pharmacy prescriptions and COVID vaccination proofs.
Also driving penalty points.

More to come..
